text:
Lina V: Who's up for a Switch split + pizza night on Wednesday? Thinking casual Smash, Mario Kart, and some co-op Splatoon rounds. Bring whatever controllers you have.

Omar N: I can bring my Switch and dock. Also have an extra Pro Controller and a couple of Joy-Cons.

June T: I'll be there, can grab pizza. Any dietary prefs? vegetarian/halal?

Maya (events): I'll run a tiny poll for pizza options and post the RSVP. Roof access code still same as last time.

Ravi P: Heads up  the dock's USB-C cable is flaky. Omar, can you bring an extra USB-C and a short HDMI?

Omar N: Yep, bringing a spare USB-C and a 2m HDMI. Also a little USB power bank if someone needs to top up Joy-Cons.

Lina V: For hygiene, please bring wipes for controllers and avoid sharing mouthguards. :sweat_smile: Also can someone bring a small surge protector?

June T: Vegetarian + gluten-free ok? I can do one GF pie.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Pizza" "Pepperoni" "Veggie + GF" "Vegan"

partybot: Poll created: "Pizza"  Pepperoni (2), Veggie + GF (1), Vegan (0).

Ravi P: Can we do one TV for Smash and one for Mario Kart? Splitting the room makes shout levels manageable.

Omar N: I'll set up the spare 24" monitor for Mario Kart. Lina, can you bring HDMI switch if we need more inputs?

Lina V: I have a little HDMI switch (4-in) and some cable ties to keep mess tidy.

June T: Time? 6pm or 7pm? I can do earlier if people want to head out for food before late trains.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start" "6pm" "7pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start"  6pm (3), 7pm (1).

Lina V: 6pm works. I'll handle printing a tiny placard for the roof door.

Omar N: Quick note for remote folks: we can run a Steam Remote Play lobby off the docked machine, but performance depends on uplink. If anyone wants to join remotely, test Parsec beforehand.

Ravi P: Also, FYI: if you're using Joy-Cons, switch to single-player handheld vs split mode to avoid accidental drift mid-race.

June T: Pizza order: 2 pepperoni, 1 veggie+GF. I'll Venmo the rest after.

Maya (events): Posted event + door code. Reminder: bring warm layers, the roof gets chilly after sunset.

Lina V: I'll bring wipes and a small speaker. Can someone film a goofy highlight for #random? 15-30s clip is perfect.

Omar N: I can record a couple rounds. See you Wednesday! :video_game:
